name: Z33
known: Board chair An Moons said the board had full confidence in director Adinda Van Geystelen and the staff (VRT NWS, Khalid Sellam and Christine Peeters, "Onderzoek naar financiële onregelmatigheden bij Z33 in Hasselt afgesloten: 'Duidelijkheid komt geen dag te vroeg'").

name: Contour Biennale
known: After a sector petition in 2024, the non-profit Contouristen, a group of Belgium-based curators, artists and cultural workers, revived it (Sabzian, Kinoki, stated by the space).
Past curators include Katerina Gregos (2009), Jacob Fabricius (2013), Natasha Ginwala (2017), Nataša Petrešin-Bachelez (2019) and Auguste Orts (2023) (stated by the space).

The 11th edition, "The Eyes of the Heart and the Soul of the World", curated by Sofia Lemos, runs from 5 September to 1 November 2026 across five sites: Kunsthal Mechelen, dmvA, TACK TICK, De Noker and the Stiltetuin at the Archbishop's Palace (e-flux).

known: Founded by Marie-Cécile Zinsou, who conceived it in 2003 after noticing that Benin had no structure for contemporary artists.

name: Museo Nacional de Etnografía y Folklore (MUSEF)
known: Elvira Espejo Ayca has been director since 2013 (CIMAM, June 2020).
The FC-BCB named the directors of its museums in February 2021, among them Espejo at MUSEF (Eju.tv, Nancy Castro, 18 February 2021).
Its director was pushed out in 2020 after a change of government and reinstated in 2021.

name: Museo de la Revolución Democrática y Cultural
Kiosko Galería
known: Raquel Schwartz is its founding director (Delfina Foundation;
She is also founding director of Nube Gallery (Delfina Foundation).
Fundación RSV, founded by Schwartz, is named on the gallery's website with the words "un proyecto de" ("a project of").

The total cost of a residency is US$1,500, paid by the artist; it covers the programme, a shared study space, a single room, common spaces and basic services, a public talk, an open day, local guidance and production and curatorial support (TransArtists).
